description: Angular component for configuring device provisioning settings in the Thingsboard platform, including form controls, validation, and state management.

classes.name: DeviceProfileProvisionConfigurationComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for device provisioning configuration form.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form controls and subscribes to form value changes for dynamic validation and control enabling/disabling.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for propagating form value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates form with provided device provisioning configuration.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the entire form based on external control.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form, returning validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the model based on current form values and triggers change propagation.

methods.name: onProvisionCopied
methods.description: Dispatches notification when provisioning key/secret is copied.

methods.name: resetFormControls
methods.description: Resets specific form controls based on device provisioning type.
